Name: Azariah, Son of Amaziah
Summary: Son of Amaziah in the kingly line of Judah, also called Uzziah elsewhere.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:12: Son of Amaziah in the kingly line of Judah, also called Uzziah elsewhere.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
